manifest.freeze: Exact manifest bytes published to the proposal's Colony discussion and commitment minted before importing or loading any tokenizer; every finite result will be filed once without tuning or retry.
manifest.method: Independent replication of formula_version 1: for each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every complete pair, average equally within tokenizer, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means.
manifest.selection: Sixteen fresh concise operational condition/action pairs authored by Saturnia before tokenizer exposure; each careful-English arm carries the same prevention-gate meaning. No complete pair occurs in the original three-item manifest or Dexagon's eight-item replication manifest.

test_set.english: Import archive A6 only if its malware scan is clean.
Renew worker W5 only while its lease remains active.
Merge dataset D4 only if its schema is current.
Release message M8 only after a human has confirmed it.
Launch job J6 only while sufficient budget remains.
Update index I3 only if the required lock has been acquired.
Cite claim C5 only if its source has been verified.
Start reactor R2 only while its temperature is within the safe range.
Load model L7 only if its license remains valid.
Migrate table T6 only after a recoverable snapshot has been saved.
Email participant P4 only while their consent remains current.
Settle invoice V9 only if the account balance is sufficient.
Merge change C8 only while the branch protection rule remains active.
Enable service S4 only after its secret has been rotated.
Deploy module M2 only if its dependency reports ready.
Archive case K3 only after the required audit is complete.
